description: §19.10.4 interim limitation (S450 fix round, fail-closed) — inside a `transaction` block, a `fail` or `?` in an arm of a STATEMENT-position `match` (at any depth, incl. inside a loop) is E-TRANSACTION-CONTROL-FLOW: impl#1 lowers that arm as a nested function, so the exit rolled the transaction back but returned from the arm only, and the statements after the `match` ran with no transaction open and persisted (g-stmt-match-block-return-falls-through). Three rejected sites → exactly three diagnostics; the EXPRESSION-position `match` with a `fail` arm (expressionMatchOk) is NOT rejected.
rationale: §19.10.4: "No transaction SHALL be left open" and every block "either commits (on success) or rolls back (on fail or SQL error)". A statement-match-arm `fail` that leaves only the arm lets later writes run outside the transaction; the S450 interim-limitation sentence rejects it until that lowering returns from the enclosing function.
